system.longDesc: Military power armor such as the Martian Goliath suit. +12 armor bonus with no penalty while operational; +10 effective bonus to Strength and Strength (Might) tests; +2 Speed and +4 to Constitution (Endurance); integral rifle doing 3d6 + Perception; +2 Dexterity (Stealth) with the camouflage package; +2 Perception with the sensor package; all benefits of a vac suit. If it loses power it becomes deadweight and the wearer is restrained. Not available for purchase.
